fusions.name: Bitter Draw
fusions.desc: Casts a hooked link at the first enemy it meets for 8 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Wormwood Drag
fusions.desc: Stretches a 6-tile chain ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches and leaves it [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Shared Purge
fusions.desc: Draws up to 3 poison conditions out of you and out of each of your allies.

fusions.name: Back Along the Link
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.
